name: YouTube Transcript Extractor
title: YouTube Transcript Extractor: Captions, Subtitles, SRT
uses: AI agents and LLM apps that summarize or answer questions about YouTube videos
Content teams repurposing videos and Shorts into posts, newsletters and blogs
RAG pipelines and datasets built from spoken content
Exporting SRT subtitles for editing and accessibility

inputs.name: videos
inputs.title: YouTube video URLs or IDs
inputs.description: Watch URLs, youtu.be links, Shorts, live or embed URLs, or bare 11-character video IDs.

inputs.name: languages
inputs.title: Preferred languages
inputs.description: Language codes in priority order, e.g. en, es, de. If none match, the first available transcript is returned.

inputs.name: translateTo
inputs.title: Translate to (optional)
inputs.description: Language code to auto-translate the transcript into using YouTube's translation, e.g. en.

inputs.name: preferManual
inputs.title: Prefer human-made captions
inputs.description: Use manually created captions over auto-generated ones when both exist.

inputs.name: includeSegments
inputs.title: Include timed segments
inputs.description: Add an array of segments with start time and duration.

inputs.name: includeSrt
inputs.title: Include SRT subtitles
inputs.description: Add an SRT subtitle file as a string.

inputs.name: proxyConfiguration
inputs.title: Proxy
inputs.description: Optional. Leave off to use our built-in residential proxy, included in the price. Set your own only if you want to.

outputs.name: availableLanguages
outputs.description: All caption tracks on the video

description: Get the transcript of any YouTube video or Short as clean text, timestamped text, segments and SRT. Bulk URLs, any language, auto-translate. Pay only for transcripts you get; failed videos are free.
